draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Great to hear things are going well -- and glad the onboarding question from your ticket got closed out.

You mentioned a walkthrough call, so let's do it: would a short call this week work? I can walk through how projects are the main organizing unit with tasks living inside them, and answer anything else as your team grows.

When you're ready to bring others in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Best,
Priya
